g.text: Diamonds: paper values. Circles: our means. Horizontal whiskers: sample SD.

g.text: All gray methods share d15/y24 input; all Gabor methods share d20/y24 pi-context input. All use seeds20-29, G2/P8 and Euclidean NN; LDA columns
have unit norm. Inputs retain prior probe exploration. See REPORT for settings and historical cosine comparisons; author aggregation is unknown.
Paper values: Xu et al., IEEE TCSVT (2008), Tables I/II/IV, doi:10.1109/TCSVT.2007.903317.
